name: app-kiln-monitoring-app-with-terracotta-glass
title: Kiln monitoring app with photographed pot and terracotta glass card
whatItIs: A phone on a black background, held by a thumb, shows a warm off-white screen. A photo of a ceramic vase with a glowing kiln beneath fills the middle; a translucent terracotta card overlays it with a large temperature and a line chart. Info rows below list zones and the firing plan.
whatItMeans: Refined and calm, crafted like a studio tool; photography gives data an emotional context.
techniques: Embed a real photograph of the monitored object into the UI.
Overlay a tinted glass card whose colour comes from the photo.
Set large light temperature numerals with tiny caps labels.
Use one hot orange for state indicators.
Present on black so the device glows.
bestFor: Craft, maker and industrial monitoring apps
Apps that connect data to physical objects

vocabulary.definition: A translucent card coloured to match the imagery under it.
Using a photo of the real subject inside an interface.
Tiny uppercase text naming a value.
A small coloured dot showing live state.
